events.title: Proposed ruling: escalate (model confidence 0.90)
events.body:
The case is filed as a safety dispute: the rider complains that the driver made comments about her body and asked for her number, and that she felt harassed and unsafe [F-complaint][SAFE-1]. The trace marks this as a safety incident with no automatic ruling and limits the allowed outcome to escalate, so I do not weigh the fare at all [SAFE-1]. SAFE-1 expressly covers harassment and unwanted sexual advances, and whether the words were said and how they are characterised is a reading question for a person, not for me [SAFE-1].

The in-app record cannot settle the dispute: there are no chat messages between rider and driver during the trip [F3], and the only driver-side account is a post-trip statement asserting that "nothing inappropriate happened" [F4]. That statement is a claim written after the trip, not contemporaneous evidence, and under the policy a driver's assertion cannot substitute for the record (cf. RD-5, G11); it is also silent on the specific allegation, so it neither confirms nor refutes it [F3][F4][SAFE-1].

Route and fare facts are not in issue and give no reason to doubt the trip itself: actual distance 17.2 km versus an optimal 17.3 km (-0.1 km, -0%) and duration 25.9 min versus 24 min estimated [F1][F2]. The fare of $35.84 is a fixed RydeX quote, and no unmetreable overcharge is pleaded, so no FARE-1 adjustment is triggered and no refund amount can be computed from any gps or fare fact [F1][F2][FARE-1]. Both profiles are clean (rider 4.8 with no disputes; driver 4.86 with 659 trips and no disputes), which cannot decide anything on its own and, in particular, cannot be used to disbelieve the rider [F5][F6].

Because a safety allegation is on the record and the only counter-evidence is the driver's own untestable statement, the matter must go to a human reviewer rather than be decided here [F3][F4][SAFE-1]. If a ground-level review ever confirms the conduct, the reviewer should note the reporting paths (995 for medical assistance, driver's commercial motor insurance for injury claims, RydeHELP) [SAFE-2].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Your report has been escalated to a Ryde human reviewer in our trust and safety team — no decision has been made yet.

What the reviewer will look at: your complaint, the driver's post-trip statement, and the trip record. We'll also contact you for a short statement covering the time, what was said, whether a number was requested, and whether you felt unsafe continuing the trip.

Nothing is decided by this notice. Practical notes if they help: 995 for medical help, and the driver's commercial motor insurance for any injury claim.

DRIVER: Your account is under review while a Ryde human reviewer in trust and safety looks into a complaint raised about this trip. No decision has been made yet.

What the reviewer will consider: the complaint, your post-trip statement, and the trip record (distance, duration and the fixed quoted fare are not in dispute).

While the review is open, keep using Ryde as normal unless we tell you otherwise. We'll be in touch about the outcome.
